home.introText: The 2379 Burlington Army Cadet Corps is a community-based youth organization that offers young Canadians aged 12–18 the opportunity to develop leadership, fitness, and citizenship skills.
home.meetingInfo: We meet every Wednesday evening at 6:30 PM.

about.heading: About Our Corps
about.mission: Our mission is to develop in youth the attributes of good citizenship and leadership, physical fitness, and stimulate an interest in the Canadian Armed Forces.
about.historyText: 2379 Burlington Army Cadet Corps has a proud tradition of serving the Burlington community and developing young leaders.

activities.heading: What We Do
activities.intro: Cadets participate in a wide range of exciting activities throughout the training year.
activities.activity1Text: Develop confidence and decision-making skills through progressive leadership courses.
activities.activity2Text: Regular fitness training, obstacle courses, and sports competitions.
activities.activity3Text: Air rifle marksmanship training in a safe, supervised environment.
activities.activity4Text: Overnight exercises, camping, and national summer training centres.

resources.heading: Cadet Resources
resources.intro: Find useful documents, forms, and links for cadets and parents.

donate.heading: Support Our Cadets
donate.intro: Your generosity helps us fund equipment, training camps, and opportunities that would otherwise be out of reach for our cadets.
donate.callToAction: Every donation — big or small — makes a real difference.
donate.leagueInfo: Donations are accepted through the Royal Canadian Army Cadet League of Canada.

badge.heading: Badge & Rank System
badge.intro: The cadet program uses a structured badge and rank system to recognise achievement and progression.
badge.level1Description: Introductory level — basic cadet training and orientation.
badge.level2Description: Fundamental skills in leadership, first aid, and drill.
badge.level5Description: Highest cadet achievement — advanced expedition and leadership.

qualification.heading: Qualifications & Courses
qualification.intro: Cadets can earn a variety of nationally recognised qualifications through the cadet program.
qualification.course1Description: Physical fitness standards and sports participation.
qualification.course2Description: Introduction to air rifle marksmanship safety and technique.
qualification.course3Description: Land navigation, camping, and wilderness survival skills.
qualification.course4Description: Formal leadership courses held at Cadet Training Centres each summer.
qualification.course5Description: Standard First Aid and CPR certification.
